data.name: Naseeh
data.gender_notes: Naseeh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'nasaaha', which means 'to advise' or 'to recommend'. This name is derived from the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) teachings to always give sincere advice and guidance to others. The name Naseeh carries the meaning “Advice, Recommendation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naseeh usually hope their child will grow to embody advice, recommendation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Guiding others towards righteousness and truth.
data.etymology: Naseeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Advice, Recommendation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naseeh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naseeh holds a deep cultural significance in the Islamic community as it reflects the essential value of providing sound advice and assistance to others. It calls to mind the noble tradition of supporting and guiding one another as integrated elements of the Islamic principle of 'Ubudhiyya' or mutual responsibility. This is highlighted in various hadiths of the Prophet Muhammad, such as his prayer for his companions: 'O Allah! Make my heart a grave for the Muslims, and their hearts a grave for me.' This tradition of giving advice and support represents a profound sense of solidarity, unity, and collectivity within the Islamic community. Hence, the name Naseeh can be seen as a reminder of the vital role that constructive and thoughtful advice plays in fostering stronger personal relationships and building harmonious societies.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Naseeh lies in its close connection to the wisdom and guidance taught in the Quran and the Sunnah. It serves as a constant reminder of the importance of striving for excellence in character, embodying 'ihsan' or self-improvement, and adhering to the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. By practicing the art of giving sincere advice and assistance, the bearer of this beautiful name is aligning themselves with the divine will and purpose, promoting love, compassion, and empathy, and offering giftsof wisdom and knowledge to others. Ultimately, the name Naseeh can be seen as a manifestation of the spiritual attributes of mercy, compassion, and kindness, as it reflects the deeply human desire to support and uplift our fellow beings on their spiritual journeys.
